text: Sasémineash another sharp cooling Fruit growing in fresh Waters all the Winter, Excellent in conserve against Feavers.

citation.display: Roger Williams, from A Key into the Language of America (1643), p. 99
citation.bibliography: Williams, Roger. "Of the Earth, and the Fruits thereof." A Key into the Language of America, Gregory Dexter, 1643, p. 99.
citation.title: Of the Earth, and the Fruits thereof

edition.title: A Key into the Language of America

species.note: The Narragansett name for the cranberry, a winter fruit of fresh water, in Williams's word list.
